views.preliminary_note: Meta's first true frontier push: agentic family with explicit memory/focus mechanisms (Active Memory/Focus defined, not slogans), Prometheus-scale training, and an OOD-generalization claim tied to base-model strength. Reader learns where Meta competes (agents/memory/coding, Harvey LAB) and what remains vendor-asserted (benchmark numbers behind report link, full safety report pending). Chronology: Oct 12 announce, research blog same week. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Hyperscaler silicon strategy made concrete: inference-first NUMA chiplets, HBM4 density, and superpod networking sized for agentic decode. Reader learns the architectural bets (data movement over raw FLOPs) and the permanent caveat (unnamed GPU baseline, internal-only, 2027 production). Tradeoff: efficiency claims vs unverifiability. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Frontier model as engineering/science instrument: global GA with aggressive intro pricing, plus unusually concrete deployment anecdotes (Chrome refactor, ADK, xTB, Gamow) and a robotics thread (ERQA, cornhole). Reader learns breadth of claimed impact and must discount for vendor sourcing; Minecraft paper (traced) shows long-horizon coding evidence with stated limits. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Agent-scale development breaks human-scale tooling: 10x merge growth forced a 5-month VCS rewrite with server-centric design. Reader learns the principles (always-online, sparse-by-design, API-first) and the boundary (internal monorepo only, not a git replacement). Engineering narrative essentially complete. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Transparency-report precedent: four misbehavior categories with cases, minimal-impact framing, live-net halt, White House briefing. Reader learns the failure taxonomy AND that severity judgments are vendor self-assessment; orgs unnamed so no independent check possible. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Frontier-model IP war made explicit: 90–99% extraction cut with named mechanisms, adversary cases (Zhipu/GLM, Kimi/PLA), and admitted trade-offs (revenue refused, <0.1% FP charged). Reader learns defenses AND costs; independent audit absent. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Reader learns the efficiency-vs-capability bargain and the Bolt split (74B now, E4B future). License OpenMDW permissive (file-level gap noted). [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Largest US open-weight release (816B/42B) with desktop-first story (2x M5 Ultra) and a custom license that is the real story: broad grant but MaaS $20M gate + attribution. Reader learns weights-vs-rights distinction; license operative terms verified, file bytes pending. [r7 substantive view; no selection implied.]

Most permissive large open-weight release (Apache full text verified) with unusually complete vendor disclosure (benchmarks at stated sampling, ISE safety with limitations, distillation allowed).
